# Ui reference

- [MatchOptionsPanel](#matchoptionspanel)

## MatchOptionsPanel

`res://assets/scripts/ui/MatchOptionsPanel.gd`, extends [`VBoxContainer`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_vboxcontainer.html)

A start menu's match options, built from the settings themselves.

One heading and a row per setting, for any object that names some of its own properties (`GameModeModule.get_match_options()`). `add_from_game_mode()` lists whichever modules the game has, so a module taken out of the project setting project_base/game_mode/modules leaves the menu; `add_section()` adds a level, an autoload or anything else. A row is made from the property's description, as the inspector does: a bool is a check box, an int with @export_enum a drop-down, an int or float a number box with its @export_range. Changing a row sets the property at once; `refresh()` reads the values again.

```gdscript
var panel := MatchOptionsPanel.new()
menu_box.add_child(panel)
panel.add_section("This level", self, PackedStringArray(["team_size", "spawn_distance"]))
panel.add_from_game_mode()
panel.add_from_autoloads()   # the tick driver's and network session's, which name their own
```

### Settings and properties

- `_rows: Array` = `[]`: Each row: [object, property name, the control]. refresh() walks these.

### Functions

- `add_section(heading: String, target: Object, names: PackedStringArray) -> void`: Adds a heading and a row for each named property of target. Names target doesn't have are skipped with a warning.
- `add_from_game_mode() -> void`: Adds a section for every GameMode module that names match options, headed by the module's node name.
- `add_from_autoloads() -> void`: Adds a section for every autoload that names match options (a get_match_options() function, as GameMode modules have), headed by its name, in the project's autoload order. The autoloads are the project setting's "autoload/" entries; one without the function (GameMode itself, the legacy ones) is skipped.
- `refresh() -> void`: Reads every value again into its row.
